$comment: The one per-request value here is the normaliser's declared placeholder {{salt:form-action}} (README, "Fixtures"). route.form carries the request's state; site.contactForm the site's form settings.
summary: The form as a visitor first meets it: name, email, an optional phone, two enquiry types, the message, the honeypot, the privacy line and an empty status. It carries no challenge and no token: they come from the form's own response, never this page, which may be cached (SC-025). The site shows its phone and email above it.
